name: Component Plastics Inc
old_description: Since 1969, CPI has been a complete source for injection molding in the Midwest. Our success is due to our ability to consistently provide customers with the highest quality parts, work within their budgets and completion dates, and ensure every customer need is met with outstanding service.
about:
Component Plastics Inc. (CPI) has operated from Elgin, Illinois since its founding in 1969. The company began as a Midwest injection molding source and has remained employee-owned throughout its history, a structure the firm credits for its ability to meet customer needs directly.

CPI specializes in custom injection molding, insert injection molding, and filter molding, including mesh insert production. Its capabilities extend to tool and die making, EDM/EDI, rapid prototyping, ultrasonic welding, supply chain management, and offshore tooling. The company supports low- to high-volume production runs for clients worldwide, applying scientific molding principles with upfront capability studies.

The manufacturer serves automotive, agricultural, industrial, medical, and telecommunications sectors. CPI notes that it still supplies its first customer from 1969, and its client base includes companies requiring vending machine components, medical device molding, and filtration solutions.

CPI emphasizes its people as its greatest differentiator, describing itself as a customer service company that molds. The firm highlights fast delivery, competitive rates, and a willingness to pivot for custom jobs, aiming to provide personalized solutions regardless of project size.
